input_units.ratio: mix-design ratio encoded in author mixture label
input_units.water: water ratio encoded in author mixture label
input_units.time_s: native penetration clock index; unit unspecified

timing_contract: Known mix label, age and elapsed penetration index only; force is never an input.
calibration: Two independent trace columns per mixture/age are retained; source average columns excluded. Time header supplies time, without an explicit unit in the workbook; the native penetration clock unit is unresolved; no physical time constant is claimed. Dimensionless t/t_ref used in equations. Mix-label ratio meanings require author PDF; do not call these stress or yield-stress measurements.
independent_unit: whole mixture across both ages and replicates

reference.equation: Frozen group-balanced Gaussian-kernel ridge: yhat = intercept + sum_j beta_j exp(-||standardized X-center_j||^2/8); exp(yhat) for positive modulus task. All scales/centers/coefficients frozen.

mechanistic_reference.equation: yhat = offset(X) + sum_j beta_j phi_j(X; frozen physical clocks), followed only by the explicit physical output bounds; exact dimensionless terms, all coefficients and clocks are in this state and run.py::basis.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared source system/people/materials, temporal dependence or small reserved-group counts do not justify precise population-level confidence. Group effects are descriptive; no row bootstrap.

scope_limits: Nine mix labels, two batches per mixture/age according to the source PDF, one early research campaign. Force–penetration-time relationships cannot identify intrinsic constitutive stress without probe kinematics/geometry.

exposure.historical_record: All packaged targets are exposed for future agents; future scoring is retrospective. Public source-aware corpus. Illustrative header/first-row values were inspected during the semantics audit; these do not constitute blind source acquisition. All delivered targets become exposed after confirmation.

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
